defect: an asynchronous reset is released through only one clocked receiving stage
rationale: rst is asynchronous to clk and the reset release reaches out through a single clk stage, leaving no second stage to contain recovery and removal uncertainty.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Asynchronous reset deassertion is synchronised by only one flop, so it can go metastable and release downstream flops unsafely.

provenance.adaptation: Kept the active-high asynchronous reset interface and reset pipeline behavior, reduced the parameterized vector to one bit, and exposed a SystemVerilog top module.

mutation.description: Reduced the reset release pipeline to one sync_reg stage before driving out.
